item.title: Send someone to the right station door
item.context_text: A friend is coming to meet you at a station with two entrances. They have a large suitcase.
item.objective_text: Give your friend a route and a meeting point they can use with a suitcase.
success_conditions: Give your friend a route and a meeting point they can use with a suitcase.

children.title: Read the station map
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: North entrance: stairs only. South entrance: lift and ticket machines. From the south doors, go left for the café and right for the toilets.

questions.explanation: The lift is marked at the south entrance.

questions.prompt: Which way from the south doors leads to the café?
questions.explanation: The map puts the café to the left.

children.title: Hear your friend’s update
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: Hello! I am on the number six bus. It stops by the north entrance. I can walk along Station Road to the other side. I have my large red suitcase.

questions.explanation: The friend names the north entrance.

questions.prompt: What can you look for when your friend arrives?
questions.explanation: They say they have a large red suitcase.

children.title: Give spoken directions
children.prompt_text: Your friend calls from the north bus stop and asks which way to go.
children.instructions: Say the street, the door and one useful reason to take that route. Repeat slowly with a pause before the meeting point.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Walk along Station Road to the south entrance. Go through the doors and take the lift. I will meet you by the café.

children.title: Write one message for the trip
children.prompt_text: Your friend’s phone battery is nearly empty. Write one message they can read at the bus stop.
children.instructions: Put the door and the reason first. Include what to do when they reach the café. Read the note as if you have never visited this station.
children.goal: Give your friend a route and a meeting point they can use with a suitcase.
children.model_answer: Use the south entrance because it has a lift. Walk along Station Road from the bus stop. Go left when you come in. I will wait at the café and look for your red suitcase.
